messages:
Anya: Heads up — noticed drilldown counts in the scorecard diff view don't match the top-level totals when we enable sampling (sample=true). Repro on nightly eval for llama-3-8b quantized run. Anyone seen this?

Mike: I think I saw something like this last week. Could be frontend not forwarding the sample param or backend aggregations ignoring the sampled table. Which run id?

Anya: run id: nightly/2026-03-18/llama3-quant-01. Steps: open scorecard, set sample=0.1, click class-level drilldown. Top-level total shows ~10,240 examples, drilldown rows sum to ~14,600. :thinking_face:

Sam: Can repro locally with the same run id. Quick check: drilldown network call doesn't include sampleFraction, so backend is doing full counts.

Carmen: Pasting a minimal log + request we captured:
```
GET /api/scorecard/drilldown?run=nightly/2026-03-18/llama3-quant-01&class=toxicity
Request query: { run: 'nightly/2026-03-18/llama3-quant-01', class: 'toxicity', sample: '0.1' }
Backend SQL executed: SELECT count(*) FROM examples WHERE run_id='nightly/2026-03-18/llama3-quant-01' AND label='toxicity'; -- no sampled_table join
```
Looks like two bugs: frontend parameter missing or misnamed, and backend aggregation may default to base table. Also fyi eval-runner-bot logged an OOM on the same nightly job (seed info below) which could explain some missing examples earlier:

eval-runner-bot: nightly/2026-03-18/llama3-quant-01 finished (seed=42), 3 batches skipped due to OOM policy, total_processed=10187

Anya: Good catch. I'll open a small frontend PR to ensure sampleFraction is always forwarded (and add a warning in UI if sample < 1).

Mike: Also we should make backend defensive: if sampleFraction provided, use sampled_table alias for all aggregations or at least return a clear sampled_total meta field. Otherwise we'll keep getting mismatches.

Sam: Quick patch I tested locally: in src/ui/scorecard/drilldown.ts change params to include sampleFraction: params.sampleFraction = params.sampleFraction || 1; and forward that to /api/scorecard/drilldown. Diff snippet:
```ts
- fetch(`/api/scorecard/drilldown?${qs(params)}`)
+ params.sampleFraction = params.sampleFraction || 1
+ fetch(`/api/scorecard/drilldown?${qs(params)}`)
```
Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4107

Carmen: I also opened a backend issue to switch the aggregation SQL to use sampled_examples when sampleFraction < 1. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4221

deploy-bot: Deployed branch pr/4107 to staging (eng-ml) at 2026-03-19T10:40:12Z :rocket:

Anya: Tested staging; drilldown sums now match top-level when sampling=0.1. Also confirmed diffpanel behavior looks consistent. Moving this to prod patch after smoke tests.

eval-runner-bot: Reran comparisons for nightly/2026-03-18/llama3-quant-01 with sample=1 and sample=0.1 on staging. Counts are consistent within 1% tolerance now.

Mike: Can we add a regression test in the scorecard reporter to check sampled_total == sum(drilldown_sampled_counts) +/- 2%? I can add that to the reporter unit tests and CI.

Sam: Agreed. I'll add an integration test that fires a small synthetic run with deterministic seed and asserts equality.

Carmen: Filed follow-ups: backport PR (#4115), add backend sampled aggregation (#4221), add reporter test (#4230). I'll link tickets in the release note.

Anya: Thanks all. Leaving this thread open until prod patch goes out and nightly rerun shows clean totals. :white_check_mark:
